caption:
Boot temperature ratings only compare within one brand. Icy pavement needs an ice-grip rubber. For deep snow both AI models choose the Sorel Caribou line; lighter everyday walking gets the Merrell Thermo Chill. 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Snow boots: deep snow or icy sidewalks? Not the same boot
